sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a simple static article/detail page: header/title area, a large hero image, long-form text content, and footer/social links. There are no visible controls such as hamburger icons, menus, tabs, accordions, forms, search, modal triggers, sticky elements, counters, or pagination/load-more affordances. Any JavaScript would therefore be optional or implementation-specific rather than implied by the sketches themselves.
